career_ladder.note: Management Trainees at Coal India Limited (CIL) and its operating subsidiaries undergo 1 year of training in IDA Grade E-2 before absorption as Assistant Manager in IDA Grade E-3, progressing through CIL's executive promotion policy across technical, mining, and corporate functions.

steps.source_label: CIL Detailed Advertisement for Recruitment of Management Trainees
CIL Common Coal Cadre Rules (Executive Cadre Absorption)
CIL Executive Board & Corporate Leadership Norms

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted through an All-India Computer Based Online Test (CBT) consisting of two papers followed by Document Verification and Initial Medical Examination (IME). There is no negative marking in the CBT.

stages.source_label: CIL Detailed CBT Syllabus and Scheme of Examination

papers.paper_name: Paper I: General Awareness, Reasoning, Numerical Ability & English
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% for General/EWS, 35% for OBC-NCL, 30% for SC/ST/PwD

papers.paper_name: Paper II: Professional Discipline Domain Knowledge
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% for General/EWS, 35% for OBC-NCL, 30% for SC/ST/PwD

stages.stage_name: Stage 2: Document Verification & Initial Medical Examination
stages.source_label: CIL Medical Attendance Rules and Document Verification Guidelines

papers.qualifying_threshold: Compliance with CIL Medical Attendance Rules for Executive Cadre

financial_package.note: Management Trainees enter at basic pay ₹50,000 in IDA Grade E-2 during 1 year training. Remuneration includes 58% IDA constant as of 2025-07-01, colliery accommodation/HRA (up to 27%), cafeteria perks (35%), underground/mining allowance where applicable, and annual PRP.
financial_package.pay_level: IDA Grade E-2 during training (₹50,000 – ₹1,60,000); Grade E-3 on absorption (₹60,000 – ₹1,80,000)
financial_package.pay_source_label: CIL Compensation Package & Service Conditions for Management Trainees
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Basic Pay ₹50,000, 58% IDA (₹29,000), HRA (up to 27% = ₹13,500), and Cafeteria Perks @ 35% (₹17,500), less statutory deductions for CMPF (Coal Mines Provident Fund) and Income Tax.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly per AICPI
Company colliery accommodation / leased housing or HRA up to 27%
Cafeteria approach perks & allowances up to 35% of basic pay
Mining / Underground allowance for operational field postings
Comprehensive medical treatment for employee and dependent family members in CIL hospitals
Coal Mines Provident Fund (CMPF), Gratuity, and Post-Retirement Medical Scheme
